description: Fix hardcoded color values in feature components. The dashboard-content.tsx uses non-existent CSS variables (--text-primary, --text-muted, --border-primary, --background-secondary) that should be replaced with the actual defined variables (--foreground, --foreground-secondary, --card-border, --card-bg). The resource-browser.tsx uses hardcoded Tailwind dark classes. The flashcard-deck loading skeleton and mistakes loading skeleton use hardcoded zinc colors. The collapsible-section.tsx and tabs-nav.tsx use non-existent variable names.
steps: Fix src/features/dashboard/components/dashboard-content.tsx: Replace all var(--text-primary) with var(--foreground), all var(--text-muted) with var(--foreground-secondary), all var(--border-primary) with var(--card-border), all var(--background-secondary) with var(--card-bg). Also replace text-[var(--text-primary)] class pattern with style={{ color: 'var(--foreground)' }} pattern. Replace text-[var(--text-muted)] with style={{ color: 'var(--foreground-secondary)' }}. Replace bg-[var(--background-secondary)] with style={{ background: 'var(--card-bg)' }}. Replace border-[var(--border-primary)] with style={{ borderColor: 'var(--card-border)' }}. For the Welcome bar 'text-[var(--text-primary)]' and 'text-[var(--text-muted)]' class patterns, convert to inline styles using the correct variables.

Fix src/features/resource-library/components/resource-browser.tsx: Replace all hardcoded Tailwind dark classes (bg-zinc-900, bg-zinc-800, bg-zinc-700, text-zinc-400, text-white, border-zinc-800, bg-blue-600) with CSS variable equivalents using inline styles. The filter buttons should use var(--card-bg)/var(--card-border) for inactive state and var(--accent-primary)/white for active state.
Fix src/app/(protected)/flashcards/page.tsx: Replace loading skeleton hardcoded 'border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/50' and 'bg-zinc-800' with style using var(--card-border) and var(--card-bg).
Fix src/app/(protected)/mistakes/page.tsx: Replace loading skeleton hardcoded 'border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/50' with style using var(--card-border) and var(--card-bg).

Fix src/shared/components/ui/collapsible-section.tsx: Replace border-[var(--border-primary)] with style borderColor var(--card-border). Replace bg-[var(--background-secondary)] with style background var(--card-bg). Replace text-[var(--text-primary)] with style color var(--foreground). Replace text-[var(--text-muted)] with style color var(--foreground-secondary). Replace hover:bg-[var(--border-primary)]/10 with a proper hover approach.

Fix src/shared/components/ui/tabs-nav.tsx: Replace text-[var(--text-muted)] with style color var(--foreground-secondary). Replace text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover reference (which doesn't exist in globals.css) with var(--foreground). Replace border-[var(--border-primary)] with style borderColor var(--card-border).
acceptance_criteria: No references to var(--text-primary), var(--text-muted), var(--text-secondary), var(--border-primary), var(--background-secondary) remain in the codebase (these are not defined in globals.css)
No hardcoded bg-zinc-*, text-zinc-*, border-zinc-* Tailwind classes in the modified files
All colors use the CSS variables defined in globals.css (--foreground, --foreground-secondary, --card-bg, --card-border, --border, --background, --background-secondary, --background-tertiary, etc.)
